(async () => {
  const result = {};
  const target = document.createElement('div');
  target.id = 'target';
  document.body.append(target);
  const cases = [
    ['nested','import-root.css',71,'load'],
    ['cycle','import-cycle.css',67,'load'],
    ['foreign','import-foreign.css',71,'error'],
    ['failure','import-missing.css',71,'error'],
    ['media','import-media.css',67,'load'],
    ['supports','import-supports.css',67,'load'],
    ['layer','import-layer.css',67,'load'],
    ['late','import-late.css',71,'load']
  ];
  for (const [name,path,width,event] of cases) {
    const link = document.createElement('link');
    link.rel = 'stylesheet';
    link.href = '/sheets-css/' + path;
    const loaded = new Promise(resolve=>{
      link.addEventListener('load',event=>resolve(event.type), {once:true});
      link.addEventListener('error',event=>resolve(event.type), {once:true});
    });
    document.head.append(link);
    result[name+'Load'] = await loaded === event;
    const style = getComputedStyle(target);
    result[name+'Cascade'] = parseFloat(style.width) === width && parseFloat(style.height) === 30 && parseFloat(style.marginLeft) === 11;
    link.remove();
  }
  target.remove();
  return result;
})()
